items.excerpt: Global venture funding to financial technology startups totaled $12 billion across 751 deals in 2026 as of April 6, per Crunchbase data. In terms of dollars invested, that’s up 5% year over year, but that money went into almost a third fewer deals.

Honaker, a former USPTO examiner and a partner with Dickinson Wright PLLC, says several factors lead him to predict mergers and acquisitions will skyrocket over the next few years. items.title: There May Be No Better Time To Sell Your Business, So Get Your IP House In Order

items.excerpt: In the startup environment where the odds are stacked against you, ADHD compounds the challenges founders face. Bogdan Nesvit, CEO and founder of Holywater, shares steps on how he defied those odds through hard work, a good team and plenty of self-awareness.

items.excerpt: Climate tech startup founders wishing to mitigate the high delivery costs of energy need to consider renewable resources available from developing nations, argues guest author Mark Dryden of Copec Wind Ventures, who shares five opportunities entrepreneurs should check out.

items.excerpt: Debt has a place in startups, but only under the right structure, circumstances and timing, writes guest author and strategic adviser Itay Sagie, who provides founder tips to avoid disaster.

items.excerpt: With capital flowing to a narrower band of outperformers and many CFOs scrambling for access, preparation and timing matter more than ever. In this guest commentary, Rob Morelli of Overlap Holdings shares five pieces of advice for CFOs looking to scale up their businesses.

items.excerpt: A platform shift is changing deep tech for physical production, argues guest author Theo Saville, as AI tooling collapses the cost and complexity of deploying sophisticated software in factories and supply chains.
